context: M4 o1. Feld Frocks, 9th floor, W 37th St. Machines roaring. Carmen waves from row three.

lines.speaker: char.sam_feld
lines.text: Arce. Your mother says you can carry. My truck didn't come. Can you carry?

lines.speaker: char.sam_feld
lines.text: Surcharge, tax, fee. My grandfather paid the czar less.

lines.speaker: char.sam_feld
lines.text: Twenty dollars. Two deliveries. Dwayne knows the way. Don't let him show off.

lines.speaker: char.dwayne_little
lines.text: Mister, I push forty racks a day. You ain't fast, you're in my way.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: That's my son! Be nice to him, Dwayne, he used to be police.

lines.speaker: char.dwayne_little
lines.text: Used to be. Okay. Keep up, used-to-be.
